CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS __greptime_table__ ( source_time TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '源时间', task_id STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '任务编号', source_type STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '来源类型', source_identity STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '本地设备卫星主键或远程卫星代号', telemetry_type STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '遥测类型', telemetry_code STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '遥测代号', telemetry_name STRING COMMENT '参数名称', value_type STRING COMMENT '遥测值类型编码', `value` DOUBLE COMMENT '遥测数值', value_text STRING COMMENT '遥测值文本原文', `raw` BINARY COMMENT '参数原码', state_name STRING COMMENT '参数状态名称原文', state_type STRING COMMENT '参数状态类型编码', state_index INT COMMENT '参数状态索引', processed_at TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '处理时间', TIME INDEX (source_time), PRIMARY KEY (task_id, source_type, source_identity, telemetry_type, telemetry_code) ) WITH ('append_mode'='false', 'merge_mode'='last_row', 'ttl'='forever')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO __greptime_table__ (source_time, task_id, interface_id, source_type, source_identity, telemetry_type, device_satellite_name, channel_name, `raw`, check_status) VALUES (#{frame.sourceTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{frame.taskId}, #{frame.interfaceId}, #{frame.sourceType}, #{frame.sourceIdentity}, #{frame.telemetryType}, #{frame.deviceSatelliteName}, #{frame.channelName}, #{frame.raw,jdbcType=VARBINARY}, #{frame.checkStatus})
